# vibey

> vibey is a free, open-source orchestrator for AI coding agents: it interviews you until the spec is sharp, builds unattended on local or paid agents, stops only for the decisions that are yours, and records every step in an append-only PostgreSQL ledger, so a crashed or out-of-credit agent's work is picked up again rather than lost.

This index is generated from the documentation's navigation by `scripts/llms_txt.py`; every link is the production copy of a page. The source is https://github.com/the-vibey-project/vibey, and the pages there are the same Markdown.

## Start here

- [Home](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/): The documentation home: what vibey is, who it is for, the one-command install, how to let another LLM drive it, and where to go next.
- [Ledger explorer](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/explorer/): Look inside a vibey project's ledger in your browser, block-explorer style. Search every public decision, question, finding and phase change, read it in plain words, check its digest yourself, and see exactly what was…
- [Current estimate](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/estimate/): The last published delivery forecast for this repository: a generated snapshot recorded 2026-10-30, with no billing and no graded track record.
- [Research paper](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/paper/): A single autonomous coding session is not autonomous software delivery: it loses its state when it crashes, it dies when one vendor's quota is exhausted mid-task, and it has no place where a person is required to decide.

## Guides

- [Install, copy, reinstall, uninstall](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/guides/install/): Install vibey with one command on macOS or Linux, set up what it needs by hand if you prefer, add any krypton app, read what vibey doctor reports, and reinstall, copy or remove it.
- [Downloads](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/guides/downloads/): The ready-built files attached to every vibey release, for each krypton app and platform, how to check a download, what is signed, and how to install each.
- [Visual tour & screenshots](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/guides/gallery/): Pictures of the krypton apps for phone, web, desktop and VS Code, with a plain note on which are design mockups and what each real screen does today.
- [VS Code extension](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/guides/vscode-extension/): Install the krypton extension in VS Code, VSCodium or Cursor, give a model on your own computer a task, review its change, and drive vibey projects from the editor's chat.
- [Drive vibey from Zed (ACP)](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/guides/acp/): Connect the Zed editor to vibey over the Agent Client Protocol, see what the first session sets up on your computer, and fix it when it does not appear.
- [Drive a project from anywhere](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/guides/drive-a-project/): Start a vibey project, answer its questions, give it files, pause, resume and unwind it, from a terminal, a chat LLM, VS Code, the desktop app or Zed.
- [Let another LLM drive vibey](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/guides/drive-from-an-llm/): Make Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, VS Code, Claude Desktop, Gemini CLI or Zed the main driver of vibey, see exactly what it may and may not do, and fix it when the tools do not appear.
- [Kubernetes](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/guides/kubernetes/): Install vibey's worker on Kubernetes with the Helm chart, decide whether to bring the eighteen sovereign surfaces along, create a project, and autoscale on claimable work with KEDA.
- [Greeter live demo](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/guides/greeter-live-demo/): Drive one small project, a command-line greeter, through DESIGN, BUILD, REVIEW and a local finish on real engines, and force one engine to hand its work to another without losing anything.
- [Local models on Ollama](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/guides/local-models-ollama/): Run vibey on a model on your own computer with Ollama, from the server settings and the two GPT-OSS builds to the local engines, unattended runs, web research and the honest limits.
- [Convergence-Driven Development](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/guides/convergence-driven-development/): Convergence-Driven Development, vibey's delivery loop above specification and tests, and how to run it by hand or let vibey run it unattended.
- [The biological philosophy](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/guides/biological-philosophy/): The biological lens vibey's development loop is built on, reading software as atoms, molecules, organisms and ecologies, and what it does and does not claim.
- [What gets published](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/guides/ledger-publication/): What `vibey ledger export` publishes from a project's ledger, what it always withholds, and how to check the counts before you commit the shard.
- [Publishing a finished project](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/guides/publishing/): Turn on publishing so a finished vibey project pushes its branch and opens a draft pull request, or creates a private GitHub repository, only when you say so.
- [Continuous delivery estimate](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/guides/delivery-estimate/): How `vibey-gh forecast` estimates the remaining delivery time and cost from real repository history, how to run it, and why the published estimate is currently stale and billing-free.
- [Self-hosted sovereign surfaces](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/guides/self-hosted-surfaces/): What the vibey Helm chart deploys for its 18 self-hosted operational surfaces, which ones need a token pasted after install, and what the chart does not set up for you.
- [The Sabbath](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/guides/sabbath/): See when vibey rests from sundown Friday to sundown Saturday, where it thinks your machine is, and how to run one command through the rest when you must.
- [Sovereign review runner](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/runbooks/sovereign-review-runner/): How to stand up, verify and remove the self-hosted runner that runs pr-review.yml's review-sovereign job on [self-hosted, vibey-local-vibey] (sub-doctrine 8.a).
- [Host optimization](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/runbooks/host-optimization/): How the machine vibey runs on is kept healthy and fitted to its workload, with every change declared in the repository, applied under a gate, measured week after week, and reversible.
- [Triaged delivery bridge](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/runbooks/triaged-delivery/): scripts/triaged_delivery.py takes triaged GitHub issues (vibey-gh:triaged) into Vibey one at a time: it dispatches a project for the issue, drives the normal worker, and publishes the finished project as a pull request.…

## Demos, by audience

- [For a non-profit](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/guides/demos/non-profit/): A walk-through for a small non-profit team that builds a volunteer shift sign-up tool on a local model with a spending brake, answers the questions only people can, and ends with a record a board can read.

## What do you want to do?

- [Overview](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/guides/outcomes/): Six short guides, each answering one question people bring to AI coding agents, with the commands, the evidence behind every claim, and the limits.
- [Run agents on your own hardware](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/guides/outcomes/run-agents-on-your-own-hardware/): Run vibey's default engine, gptossloop, on the Heretic v2 build of GPT-OSS 20B in Ollama and allow no other; the queue, ledger and model stay on your machine, and web search and page reads can be shut off too.
- [Cap and trace agent spending](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/guides/outcomes/cap-agent-spending/): Set a per-cycle dollar or turn cap with vibey budget set; the brake reads it before every BUILD session and parks a gate when it trips, and vibey cost shows each engine's spend from the ledger.
- [Keep a tamper-evident record](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/guides/outcomes/keep-a-tamper-evident-record/): vibey appends every decision, question, answer, handoff and cost to a PostgreSQL ledger that its application role cannot rewrite, and each export walks a SHA-256 chain over every event to show an edit.
- [Review AI changes before merge](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/guides/outcomes/review-ai-changes-before-merge/): vibey stops at a REVIEW gate that waits for your verdict, and vibey-gh binds every check and review on a GitHub pull request to its exact head commit, so the merge train merges only what passed on that commit.
- [Deploy without holding cloud secrets](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/guides/outcomes/deploy-without-storing-secrets/): Partly, and not yet for production; vibey's opt-in Azure stages keep no cloud credential, act as the az CLI identity you signed in with, and change nothing until you consent, but no real-Azure run is proven yet.
- [Use vibey in a regulated environment](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/guides/outcomes/take-vibey-into-a-regulated-environment/): vibey holds no certification, but it gives an assessor concrete mechanisms to examine, each linked to its evidence, and it says plainly which controls stay with you.

## Case studies

- [How vibey survives a crashed agent](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/case-studies/how-vibey-survives-a-crashed-agent/): When an AI coding agent crashes mid-task, vibey loses no job and commits no job twice — leases, an append-only ledger and parked human gates, with the chaos test that proves it and the costs it pays.

## Continuation prompts

- [Resume](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/continuation/resume/): The continuation prompt that orients an agent in vibey as it stands and continues delivery where the project left off.
- [Keep develop green](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/continuation/keep-green/): The continuation prompt that finds every failing workflow on vibey's integration branch, fixes its cause, and lands the fix as a pull request.
- [Release](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/continuation/release/): The continuation prompt that derives vibey's next version, promotes develop to main, and verifies every published channel and asset.
- [Triage](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/continuation/triage/): The continuation prompt that keeps vibey's backlog, issue tracker and living roadmap truthful.
- [Work the backlog](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/continuation/backlog/): The continuation prompt the backlog killer runs once per 60-minute slot, on the operator's own machine and paused since 2026-10-29: land the smallest shippable, tested slice of one opted-in issue as a draft pull request.
- [Keep the documentation true](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/continuation/docs/): The continuation prompt the daily documentation updater runs: find one statement in the documentation, the research paper or the book that the repository now contradicts, and correct it.
- [Research and measurement](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/continuation/research/): The continuation prompt that keeps vibey's weekly measurements and registered studies running without breaking their protocols.
- [Succession](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/continuation/succession/): The continuation prompt that hands vibey to a new steward — what they must hold, where each thing is declared, and how to verify it, with no secret ever written down.
- [Rebuild](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/continuation/rebuild/): The continuation prompt that reconstitutes vibey from any surviving copy — a clone, a release's source distribution, or the book — if the forge, the runner or the operator is gone.
- [Chat](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/continuation/chat/): Talk to vibey's own agent inside GitHub — write /vibey in an issue or pull-request comment, or run the Chat workflow from the Actions tab, and an open-weights model on a GitHub runner answers.

## Reference

- [CLI](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/reference/cli/): Every vibey command, subcommand, flag, default and exit code, and every environment variable vibey reads, checked against the code.
- [Error codes](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/reference/errors/): Every error code vibey prints, what it means and the command that fixes it, generated from the error catalog that vibey explain also reads.
- [Configuration](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/reference/configuration/): Every vibey.toml table and key: its type and default, which file it is read from, who may set it, the code that reads it, and the environment variables that override it.
- [Hub API](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/reference/hub-api/): Every route of the vibey hub's HTTP API, the scope each one needs, what it returns and how it refuses; the OpenAPI document hub-api.json is the contract.
- [System requirements](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/reference/system-requirements/): What a machine needs to run vibey and its krypton clients, and how each figure is known.
- [Distance from full autonomy](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/reference/autonomy/): How far vibey is from running its whole delivery loop without a person, stage by stage, measured weekly from the forge, the review canary, the code and the local queue.
- [Host health](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/reference/host-health/): How healthy is the machine vibey and krypton run on, and how long until it needs replacing?
- [Context microslices](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/context-microslices/): The proposed microslice contract for anything loaded into a model's context, the converter that slices Markdown, the generated tree under docs/microslices, and the context engine that compiles bounded packets.

## Design

- [The design system](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/design/): Every colour, face, size, space, radius, shadow, curve and sound cue that a vibey surface uses comes from one place: design/tokens/.
- [Motion](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/design/motion/): Motion in vibey and krypton explains.
- [The Beauty Bar](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/design/beauty-bar/): The checkable bar that sub-doctrine 12.k (beauty is the first measure) cites.

## Architecture — Decision records

- [0001 — Orchestrate the *loop runners; do not reimplement them](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0001-orchestrate-do-not-reimplement/)
- [0002 — PostgreSQL, not SQLite, for the queue and ledger](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0002-postgres-not-sqlite/)
- [0003 — An event-sourced ledger is the conversation's source of truth](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0003-event-sourced-ledger/)
- [0004 — Handoffs are gated by a deterministic no-loss predicate](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0004-no-loss-gate-on-handoff/)
- [0005 — Smooth weighted round robin, not modulo rotation](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0005-smooth-weighted-round-robin/)
- [0006 — A normalized effort ladder with saturating per-engine projection](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0006-normalized-effort-ladder/)
- [0007 — Rotate at boundaries, never mid-turn](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0007-rotate-at-boundaries/)
- [0008 — Git worktree per work item; containers for real isolation](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0008-worktree-isolation/)
- [0009 — Human gates park jobs; they never block workers](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0009-human-gates-are-parked-jobs/)
- [0010 — Review loops back to design by default, to build on the fast path](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0010-review-loopback-routing/)
- [0011 — One source of truth, materialized into every engine's guidance files](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0011-agent-surface-provisioning/)
- [0012 — Deployment is a separate CLI built on azure-bootstrap](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0012-deploy-is-a-separate-cli/)
- [0013 — Deployment is a three-phase stage set in the core lifecycle](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0013-deployment-is-a-three-phase-stage-set/)
- [0014 — Optional visual design and deployment opt-in gates](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0014-optional-visual-design-and-deployment-opt-in/)
- [0015 — qwenloop is an opt-in local engine — a standby tier for BUILD, the sovereign provider for DESIGN](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0015-qwenloop-standby/)
- [0016 — Code lives in classes, and every class has an interface beside it](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0016-classes-behind-interfaces/)
- [0017 — If the family already does it, the family does it here](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0017-dogfood-the-family-first/)
- [0018 — If it can be declared in the repository, it is declared in the repository](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0018-everything-as-code/)
- [0019 — Vibey is installable wherever its users already are](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0019-installable-wherever-its-users-are/)
- [0020 — A governing rule belongs in the canon, ratified, or it is not a rule](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0020-governing-rules-are-ratified-subdoctrines/)
- [0021 — One tree, history preserved — the family is absorbed as subtrees in a uv workspace](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0021-one-tree-history-preserved/)
- [0022 — An absorbed package keeps every gate it was already held to](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0022-absorbed-packages-keep-their-own-gates/)
- [0023 — Four layers, four floors — 100% branch coverage per layer, each its own gate](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0023-four-layers-four-floors/)
- [0024 — Every bounded ladder ends in a park that can grant more](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0024-every-bounded-ladder-parks-with-a-grant/)
- [0025 — Kubernetes — a chart, KEDA on claimable work, and an operator that never grows its own logic](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0025-kubernetes-operator-crd-keda/)
- [0026 — tini is PID 1, and the SIGTERM latch is armed before the first import](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0026-tini-pid1-and-the-sigterm-latch/)
- [0027 — A sovereign DESIGN provider — phase one runs without paid credit](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0027-sovereign-design-provider/)
- [0028 — vibey-gh owns provenance and release; release-please is retired](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0028-vibey-gh-owns-release-and-provenance/)
- [0029 — Integrates are serialized by a Postgres advisory lock, and contention is a Defer](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0029-integrate-serialized-by-advisory-lock/)
- [0030 — The live harness has two modes — faked by default, paid by explicit choice](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0030-two-mode-live-harness/)
- [0031 — Skills context is a packet compiled over a process boundary, shadow before inject](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0031-skills-context-packets-over-a-process-boundary/)
- [0032 — The documentation ships as a research paper and a book, findable everywhere and built to outlive the site](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0032-the-docs-ship-as-a-paper-and-a-book/)
- [0033 — Governance in plain sight — the law is as easy to find and as visible as possible, on every human-readable surface](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0033-governance-in-plain-sight/)
- [0034 — One Claude Code marketplace at the repository root, rendered from the workspace members](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0034-one-marketplace-at-the-root/)
- [0035 — Verify independence is the default, not an absolute](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0035-independence-is-the-default-not-an-absolute/)
- [0036 — The merge queue is declared, not clicked](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0036-the-merge-queue-is-declared-not-clicked/)
- [0037 — One distribution, one version — the whole family ships inside vibey](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0037-one-distribution-one-version/)
- [0038 — Local engines are preferred first (8.a) — claudeloop-local, tiered selection, and sovereign DESIGN/DECOMPOSE by default when enabled](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0038-local-engines-are-preferred-first/)
- [0039 — Convergence-Driven Development (CDD) encloses specification and test-driven development](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0039-convergence-driven-development/)
- [0040 — Evidence-bounded status for runs, features and research claims](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0040-evidence-bounded-status/)
- [0041 — Software organisms are alive in the digital realm](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0041-software-organisms-alive-in-the-digital-realm/)
- [0042 — Sovereign self-hosted defaults on every surface; paid platforms are declared-only relays](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0042-sovereign-self-hosted-defaults-and-declared-paid-relays/)
- [0043 — Sovereign operational surfaces deploy into the Kubernetes cluster with reconciled health](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0043-sovereign-surfaces-install/)
- [0044 — The job queue is a port; RabbitMQ dispatches and every loop runs as one service](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0044-job-queue-port-and-loop-services/)
- [0045 — Every deployment measures the machine it runs on and fits itself to it](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0045-fitted-to-the-iron/)
- [0046 — Standing authority to act unattended is bounded by a gate a human defined](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0046-unattended-authority-is-bounded-by-a-gate/)
- [0047 — Anything that can be fully automated to make a developer's life better is](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0047-the-toil-is-automated/)
- [0048 — A job that consumes an accumulating record reads every datum in the gap](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0048-the-unbroken-read/)
- [0049 — A named agent may approve an unattended change, and is never its author](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0049-the-delegated-approver/)
- [0050 — The harness and every automation are kept fast, and speed never buys less measurement](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0050-the-machinery-does-not-waste-a-persons-time/)
- [0051 — Configuration is declared in TOML, never written into a source file](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0051-nothing-is-compiled-in-that-could-be-declared/)
- [0052 — A tracker is kept true by the machinery that changes what it describes](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0052-the-tracker-tells-the-truth/)
- [0053 — An unattended run takes direction only from the operator's account](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0053-the-unattended-run-admits-no-stranger/)
- [0054 — A bumped job runs next, first in first out, and only the operator or a declared source may bump](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0054-a-bumped-job-runs-next/): accepted (cited by #1089, the storm's priority lane, and by #1091, vibey's job queue; the storm conforms to items 4–7 once #1092 merges — see Conformance below) · Date: 2026-09-24 · Cites: sub-doctrines 8.c, 12.j, 12.h…
- [0055 — The ledger is append-only by the database, not by convention](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0055-the-ledger-is-append-only-by-the-database/)
- [0056 — Everything a queue guards is reaped by measurement](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0056-everything-a-queue-guards-is-reaped-by-measurement/)
- [0057 — Storm work lives on durable storage, is committed and pushed often, and a tool refuses volatile paths](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0057-the-work-outlives-the-machine/)
- [0058 — Concurrent runs of a local model are measured on each device, and unmeasured or stale means one](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0058-concurrent-local-runs-are-measured-per-device/)
- [0059 — The editor drives the family's own loops, on a copy, and adds no loop of its own](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0059-the-editor-drives-the-familys-own-loops/)
- [0060 — The heartbeat tells the truth, and passes the gate by the gate's own rule](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0060-the-heartbeat-tells-the-truth-and-passes-the-gate-by-its-rule/)

- [0086 — vibey state: the whole database, sealed on a branch, kept in sync both ways](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0086-state-sync/)

- [0088 — TypeScript, never JavaScript: the only authored form is typed, and the JavaScript that must exist is generated](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0088-typescript-never-javascript/)
- [0089 — AI self-reference is I; inclusive we is only direct address](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0089-ai-self-reference-is-i-inclusive-we-is-direct/)

- [0092 — Large tasks are sliced into the CDD layers before they run](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0092-large-tasks-are-sliced-into-the-cdd-layers-before-they-run/)

- [0094 — The cost of routing the cache through its lane is accepted](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0094-the-cost-of-routing-the-cache-through-its-lane-is-accepted/)
- [0095 — OpenTofu is the infrastructure-as-code tool for AWS deployments](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0095-opentofu-is-the-infrastructure-as-code-tool-for-aws/)
- [0096 — On Forgejo, branch rules are mapped where Forgejo can express them and waived loudly where it cannot](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0096-on-forgejo-branch-rules-are-mapped-where-they-can-be-and-waived-loudly-where-they-cannot/)

- [0102 — Local-first search, and the SearXNG vibey installs and runs itself](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0102-local-first-search-and-a-provisioned-searxng/)

## Governance

- [The Constitution](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/governance/constitution/): The permanent, living governance of this project and its family.
- [The Twelve Doctrines](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/governance/doctrines/): There is no thirteenth and there never will be: anything new files as a sub-doctrine under one of the twelve.
- [The Ten Commandments of Software Engineering](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/governance/commandments/): Binding on every agent that works here — human and machine alike.
- [The Bill of Rights of the Human Software Engineer](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/governance/bill-of-rights/): Nothing is ever added beyond these; from their sealing forward, only refinements of the existing ten are made — refinements that may strengthen a right, never weaken one.
- [Subdoctrine SD-01 — Counterparties, Trust, and Verification](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/governance/sd-01-counterparties-trust-verification/): This page carries a standing rule of this project: how any agent acting for it treats every counterparty — people, companies, executives, states, and other software.

## Offline forms

- [Research paper (PDF)](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/paper.pdf): The design as a journal-formatted paper.
- [The book (PDF)](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/book.pdf): Every page of this site, in navigation order, as one book.
- [The book (EPUB)](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/book.epub): The same book for e-readers.
